abstract: BACKGROUND: In recent years, there has been a move toward using laparoscopy in the management of presumed benign ovarian masses. This paper discusses the use of laparoscopy for ovarian masses (particularly dermoid cysts). The focus is on the implications for unexpected malignancies. CASE: We report here a case involving a dermoid cyst that was removed at laparoscopy and was subsequently found to contain a squamous cell carcinoma. Spillage of the cyst's contents occurred at the time of removal. At staging laparotomy, peritoneal implants of the tumor were found, upgrading the tumor from FIGO stage Ia to IIc. CONCLUSION: Spillage rates of dermoid cyst content with laparoscopic removal are inevitably higher than with excision at laparotomy. It remains controversial whether upstaging from FIGO stage Ia to IIc affects prognosis; however, in this case it led to aggressive adjuvant therapy which imposed significant additional morbidity, including loss of fertility, on the patient. One should be aware of the possibility of unexpected malignancy when the decision to manage an ovarian mass laparoscopically is made.

背景：近年、予想される良性の卵巣腫瘤に対して腹腔鏡手術を用いる傾向が強まっている。本稿では、特に類皮嚢腫の腹腔鏡手術について論じ、予期せぬ悪性腫瘍への影響に焦点を当てる。
症例：腹腔鏡下に摘出した類皮嚢腫から扁平上皮癌が見つかった症例を報告する。摘出時に嚢胞内容物の漏出が生じた。病期分類のための開腹術で腹膜播種が確認され、FIGO病期Iaから病期IIcへ上方修正された。
結論：腹腔鏡下摘出では、開腹下での摘出に比べて類皮嚢腫内容物の漏出率が必然的に高くなる。FIGO病期Iaから病期IIcへの病期上昇が予後に影響するかは議論の余地があるが、本症例では積極的な補助療法が行われ、妊孕性の喪失を含む患者の有意な負担となった。卵巣腫瘤を腹腔鏡で扱うことを決定する際には、予期せぬ悪性腫瘍の可能性を認識しておくべきである。
